en: Conditioned by a sublime, non-unwholesome state, a sublime, wholesome state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Nine under root; ... pe ... nine under non-disappearance.
Conditioned by a sublime, non-unwholesome state, a limited, unwholesome state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a limited indeterminate state, a limited indeterminate state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. There are six under root, six under predominance … pe … six under non-disappearance.
